topics.title: Resolve agent profiles through one archive-aware selector

entries.title: Resolve agent profiles through one archive-aware selector
entries.rationale: Accepted as an archive-aware identity truthfulness change. Preserve archived-agent exclusion, loading/error fail-closed behavior, canonical instance selection, and parity across profile entry points.
security_reasons: archived identities must not remain actionable through stale profile paths
one canonical selector controls which managed instance receives actions
relay archive loading and unknown states must not fail open
profile/runtime data must not be mixed across identities

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated identity/archive threat review, selector parity tests, loading/error tests, dependency screening, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and desktop/Tauri gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, archive-aware selectors, profile entry points, changed tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
